text:
QUOTE: There is no indirection, and the runtime setter is compiled out (`platform.c:20-22`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer's "no indirection" statement applies only to a user-defined MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO build. It never says a default build has `mbedtls_calloc`/`mbedtls_free` as macros expanding to `calloc`/`free`. It describes a default of function pointers and an uninitialized stub.
